title: Timothy Carney, Diplomat Who Went Places Others Avoided, Dies at 82
summary_full: Insisting on seeing things for himself, even in hostile terrain, Mr. Carney opposed the closing of the U.S. embassy in Khartoum while Osama Bin Laden established himself there.
